lowest_plane_contact_screen.interpretation: Geometric contact screen only; no supports, raft, exposure or adhesion qualification.

method: Read saved triangles at the exact minimum Z plane; separately select saved vertices within 0.2 mm above that plane. No remeshing or pose change.
scope_limitations: This is geometric contact area, not cured resin adhesion, support adequacy or a slicer simulation.
The extremely small contact area does not provide a basis to approve unsupported printing in the saved pose.
Supports, raft, printer envelope, resin, peel force, washing and physical printing remain unqualified.
